name: benchy_pirate_ship
description: Black Pearl-style pirate Benchy: black hull, red cabin walls, yellow cabin roof, black smokestack, white waterline. Z-axis is bed→top. Tags map by name; defaults assume palette={yellow:2, black:1, red:4, white:3}. Tested on a 3DBenchy.stl with bbox 60x31x48 mm.

fingerprint.comment: 3DBenchy — boat-shaped (longer than tall than wide), 1-3 components depending on STL source, no significant recesses (the cabin opening is rendered as concave but the recess detector typically buckets it as a vertical_side rather than a recess_*). Tuned against the canonical 60×31×48 mm 3DBenchy.stl.

steps.comment: Waterline stripe (z 0..2.5) — white, only on currently-black hull
